name: staffing-math
description: Exact staffing math: FTE needed for a workload, a monthly hiring plan, and Erlang C queue staffing, with the arithmetic shown.
long_description: Three read-only tools for planning a team's headcount. Every answer lists its inputs as given or assumed and shows the arithmetic, so it can be checked with a calculator. The math is the Operating Model Simulator engine.

tools.name: required_fte
tools.description: How many people a steady workload needs.

tools.name: hiring_plan
tools.description: Requisitions to open each month so capacity keeps up with a forecast.

tools.name: erlang_staffing
tools.description: Agents a phone or chat queue needs to hit an answer-time target.
